_comment: Friendly active_model key (what the Discord 'cy: model <key>' command writes to Halseth companion_settings) -> Hermes model.* config. The hermes-model-watcher re-reads this file every cycle, so edits apply live (no watcher restart). 'default' is the bare Hermes model id (no provider prefix). 'provider'/'base_url' are only needed when the key switches PROVIDER (e.g. openrouter, local); for same-provider DeepSeek rungs they are a harmless no-op rewrite. Stage 2 adds openrouter/local entries once your keys are in each profile .env.
_cloud_note: Built-in Hermes providers carry their own base_url + key_env, so NO base_url/api_key here; the watcher strips any stale override on switch so the preset + env key are used. Provider names are Hermes-canonical (anthropic/openai-api/gemini/kimi-coding/ollama-cloud/openrouter). DeepSeek/Kimi/Claude/Ollama/Gemini-2.5 keys smoke-tested via `hermes -z` 06-28 (full agent ran in voice). The GPT-5.x and gemini-3 keys (added 06-28 to track current provider lineups -- gpt-4o/gpt-4o-mini are now legacy, GPT-5.5/5.4 are current; gemini-2.5 is still GA but gemini-3-flash is the current Flash) should be `hermes -z` smoke-tested once before relying on them in production. Gemini is a NATIVE adapter -- never give it a base_url. Mistral has no native provider so it routes via OpenRouter.
_local_note: LM Studio on your workstation, reached via the reverse tunnel at VPS 127.0.0.1:11435. provider 'custom' + base_url + a dummy api_key (LM Studio ignores it). Keys match the bot's ALL_MODELS so /model <key> reaches them. Model must be loaded/JIT-available in LM Studio.
